bio.text: Caroleene Dobson is a Republican candidate for Alabama secretary of state in 2026.
She is a shareholder at the Maynard Nexsen law firm in Montgomery, where she focuses on natural resources, commercial finance and real estate law.
She was born and raised on her family's farm in Monroe County, and holds an undergraduate degree from Harvard College and a law degree from Baylor University School of Law.
She ran in Alabama's 2nd Congressional District in 2024, losing to Democrat Shomari Figures.
